# output only counts, not hit locations

checks.name: source_custody
checks.scope: supplied producer attempt and exact ordered source artifact identities/digests; independent symbol checks do not establish custody

checks.name: decoded_layout
checks.scope: declared ABI, all metadata/arrays, framing, occurrence digest and byte count

checks.name: dna_reader_compatibility
checks.scope: HMMER 3.4 fm_readFMmeta accepts DNA only; amino writer decoding is separate

checks.name: metadata_partition
checks.scope: forward block sections refer once to every ordered segment/range row; paired sections share those rows

checks.name: block_offsets
checks.scope: segment and ambiguity spans refer to retained metadata rows

checks.name: decoded_array_symbols
checks.scope: saved decoded strings agree with full packed arrays; calculations use the arrays

checks.name: counter_rows
checks.scope: every b/sb row; encoded BWT includes sentinel as alphabet[0]; native uint16 wrap retained

checks.name: sentinel_encoding
checks.scope: BWT term_loc and stored original T final symbol use alphabet[0] as sentinel placeholder

checks.name: bwt_text_consistency
checks.scope: full LF cycle and each preceding symbol against reversed T (forward section) or T (reverse section)

checks.name: suffix_samples
checks.scope: all sampled LF suffix positions; sample zero and unused trailing slot are writer zeros

checks.name: ambiguity_bounds
checks.scope: ordered disjoint zero-based inclusive ranges within this block's nonsentinel text

checks.name: block_segment_coverage
checks.scope: segments partition nonsentinel T without internal gaps or overlaps

checks.name: segment_coordinates
checks.scope: target_id indexes supplied original source order; one-based source interval and zero-based block interval

checks.name: segment_name
checks.scope: label agreement only, not historical custody or unique identity

checks.name: source_symbols_outside_ambiguities
checks.scope: case-folded source; only caller-selected U-to-T normalization; recorded ambiguous positions excluded

checks.name: source_ambiguity_membership
checks.scope: each original non-ACGTU DNA symbol equals recorded ambiguity membership

checks.name: segment_coordinates
checks.scope: target_id indexes supplied original source order; one-based source interval and zero-based block interval

checks.name: segment_name
checks.scope: label agreement only, not historical custody or unique identity

checks.name: source_symbols_outside_ambiguities
checks.scope: case-folded source; only caller-selected U-to-T normalization; recorded ambiguous positions excluded

checks.name: source_ambiguity_membership
checks.scope: each original non-ACGTU DNA symbol equals recorded ambiguity membership

checks.name: block_overlap
checks.scope: declared block overlap equals source-coordinate overlap with earlier blocks

checks.name: block_offsets
checks.scope: segment and ambiguity spans refer to retained metadata rows

checks.name: paired_block_metadata
checks.scope: paired sections share populations; reverse writer overlap is zero

checks.name: decoded_array_symbols
checks.scope: saved decoded strings agree with full packed arrays; calculations use the arrays

checks.name: counter_rows
checks.scope: every b/sb row; encoded BWT includes sentinel as alphabet[0]; native uint16 wrap retained

checks.name: sentinel_encoding
checks.scope: BWT term_loc and stored original T final symbol use alphabet[0] as sentinel placeholder

checks.name: bwt_text_consistency
checks.scope: full LF cycle and each preceding symbol against reversed T (forward section) or T (reverse section)

checks.name: suffix_samples
checks.scope: reverse section stores no SA

checks.name: source_coverage
checks.scope: union of source-coordinate segment intervals covers this complete supplied sequence

checks.name: source_coverage
checks.scope: union of source-coordinate segment intervals covers this complete supplied sequence

checks.name: total_char_count
checks.scope: declared total, supplied source symbols, and sum(N-1-overlap) agree; no completeness inference for matches

checks.name: native_query_population
checks.scope: count-only Q+R=N; locations Q+R<=N because native filters can discard every raw match; H>=Q

checks.name: native_location_count
checks.scope: native location H versus parsed emitted rows; does not assert literal validity

checks.name: native_location_query_count
checks.scope: native location Q versus emitted query groups; duplicate query occurrences stay separate

checks.name: count_only_has_no_locations
checks.scope: count-only output must contain no locations; missing file remains missing
